scripts.build: npm run build -w @wai/shared && npm run build -w @wai/storage && npm run build -w @wai/browser && npm run build -w @wai/discovery
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @wai/shared && npm run typecheck -w @wai/storage && npm run typecheck -w @wai/browser && npm run typecheck -w @wai/discovery
scripts.test: npm run test -w @wai/shared && npm run test -w @wai/storage && npm run test -w @wai/browser && npm run test -w @wai/discovery
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
